subject.title: feat: add session stream mode command

question: Should OpenClaw accept `/stream` as a persisted session-scoped preview streaming override for Telegram, Discord, and Slack via `SessionEntry.streamingMode` and a channel capability gate?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but it adds a durable session field and plugin/channel capability surface that require maintainer product and API ownership rather than an automatic cleanup decision.

options.title: Accept the MVP after rebase
options.body: Approve the session-scoped command design, require a clean rebase and latest-head live proof, then proceed with normal review.

options.title: Narrow to one channel first
options.body: Limit the feature to the most proven channel while maintainers settle the shared capability and session-state contract.

options.title: Reject core command surface
options.body: Close or redesign the PR if preview streaming controls should stay in channel/plugin-specific configuration rather than core slash commands.

recommendation.title: Accept the MVP after rebase
recommendation.body: Approve the session-scoped command design, require a clean rebase and latest-head live proof, then proceed with normal review.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans session state and preview streaming helper history where steipete has the strongest overlapping commit trail.
